"""Main's exact integrated source review and model-free host regression suite."""
import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012')
P = W.parent / 'diag-xe-host-issuer-ledger-20261012'
X = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('integrated_host_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=str(X / '.lint/venv/bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', USER='yayoi', LOGNAME='yayoi',
           LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',
           HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1', TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--phase', choices=['review', 'cpu'], required=True)
    phase = parser.parse_args().phase
    with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        out = B / ('latest-update-integrated-' + phase + '-host-root-v5')
        assert not out.exists()
        out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, phase=phase, commands=[], environment=ENV,
                 source_tree=str(W), controller_sha256=m.sha(__file__), owner_sha256=m.sha(O),
                 gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, native_bias_enabled=False, performance_measured=False)
        def save(): (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
        owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
        r['commands'] = owner.commands
        def cmd(label, argv, wall=60):
            c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, W, wall=wall, cpu=wall*4, text_cap=64 << 20,
                                  total_cap=64 << 20, file_cap=64 << 20, rss_cap=16 << 30)
            e = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
            r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = e
            save()
            m.require(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label + ' anchored normal success')
            return e
        def tests(label, argv, wall=1200):
            e = cmd(label, [str(X / '.lint/venv/bin/python3'), '-B', '-m', 'unittest', *argv], wall)
            match = re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests in ([0-9.]+)s', e['stderr'])
            m.require(match and re.search(r'^OK(?:\s|$)', e['stderr'], re.M), 'complete unittest status')
            skips = re.search(r'^OK \(skipped=(\d+)\)', e['stderr'], re.M)
            r.setdefault('unittests', {})[label] = dict(tests=int(match[1]), elapsed_seconds=float(match[2]),
                skipped=int(skips[1]) if skips else 0, individual_results=[s for s in e['stderr'].splitlines() if s.startswith('test_')])
        try:
            r['base_revision'] = cmd('head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])['stdout'].strip()
            m.require(r['base_revision'] == '337255086026f6eef21a861c297183d05a5f7a22', 'immutable base')
            if phase == 'review':
                # Root shell files are globally ignored on this host, but this is new reviewed source.
                (W / 'bench.sh').chmod(0o755)
                cmd('track-benchmark-launcher', ['/usr/bin/git', 'add', '-f', '--', 'bench.sh'])
                changed = cmd('changed', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'HEAD'])['stdout'].splitlines()
                changed += cmd('new', ['/usr/bin/git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard'])['stdout'].splitlines()
                r['changed_source_pins'] = {p: m.sha(W / p) for p in sorted(set(changed))}
                r['source_diff'] = cmd('diff', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', 'HEAD', '--', *sorted(set(changed))])['stdout']
                cmd('diff-check', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--check', 'HEAD'])
                r['new_source_files'] = {p: (W / p).read_text() for p in changed if not (P / p).exists()}
                files = cmd('source-list', ['/usr/bin/git', 'ls-files'])['stdout'].splitlines()
                files = {p for p in files if p.startswith(('src/', 'include/', 'tools/', 'serve/', 'cmake/', 'third_party/'))
                         or p in ['CMakeLists.txt', 'setup.py', 'REUSE.toml', 'NOTICE', 'requirements.txt']}
                files.update(changed)
                r['source_pins'] = {p: m.sha(W / p) for p in sorted(files) if (W / p).is_file()}
                r['main_reviewed'] = True
                r['review_limits'] = 'SourceOnly; benchmark auto-start/log ownership remains under separate review; native bias stays unsupported; full262144/device/model validation pending'
            else:
                rp = B / 'latest-update-integrated-review-host-root-v5/record.json'
                review = json.loads(rp.read_text())
                m.require(review['passed'] and review['complete'] and not review['active'] and review['main_reviewed'], 'Main source review')
                m.require(all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p, h in review['source_pins'].items()), 'reviewed source stable')
                r['source_review_sha256'] = m.sha(rp)
                r['source_pins'] = review['source_pins']
                tests('full-server-regression', ['discover', '-s', 'serve', '-p', 'test_*.py', '-v'])
                tests('archive-effort-http-bench', ['-v', 'tools.test_setup_llama_archive',
                    'tools.test_effort_end_args', 'tools.test_strata_bench'])
            m.require(all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p, h in r['source_pins'].items()), 'source unchanged throughout')
            r['passed'] = True
        except BaseException as error:
            r['error'] = repr(error)
        finally:
            r.update(active=owner.active is not None, complete=owner.active is None, finished_utc=m.utc())
            save()
        print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['phase', 'passed', 'error', 'unittests']}))
        return 0 if r['passed'] else 1

if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
